lines.text: Jehoram son of Ahab became king of Israel and removed the sacred pillar of Baal that his father had made.
After Ahab died, Mesha king of Moab rebelled, so Jehoram asked Jehoshaphat of Judah to fight Moab with him.
The three kings went by way of the Wilderness of Zin and after seven days had no water.
Jehoshaphat asked for a prophet, and Elisha told them to dig the valley full of ditches.
Israel struck down the Moabites, and after the king of Moab offered his firstborn son on the city wall, Israel withdrew to Judah.
